title: Methylcarvones as immunomodulators through antagonism of aryl hydrocarbon receptor.
authors: Zuvalova, Iveta; Grycova, Aneta; Hruby, Jiri; Illes, Peter; Soural, Miroslav; Kovac, Ondrej; Sebela, Marek; Bachleda, Petr; Kriegova, Eva; Trajerova, Marketa; Dvorak, Zdenek
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甲基化香芹酮作为芳香烃受体(AhR)的免疫调节拮抗剂，涉及小分子-蛋白对接，但对象为AhR而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Monocyclic monoterpenoids have been demonstrated as atypical negative allosteric modulators of aryl hydrocarbon receptor AhR. The alkylation of the skeleton has been identified as a factor modulating the AhR antagonist activity of S-carvone. In the present study, we synthesized methylated derivatives of S-carvone, and a complex series of experimental approaches has been employed to characterize the interactions of novel compounds with AhR. Molecular docking to AhR carvone-binding site revealed binding energies for 6-methylated carvones superior to that of S-carvone. This prediction was corroborated by microscale thermophoresis, where 6-methylated carvones displayed stronger binding to AhR N-terminal region, as compared to S-carvone. Methylated carvones inhibited AhR transcriptional activity in vitro in cell lines, as revealed by reporter gene assay and RT-PCR. However, their effects were weaker than those predicted by molecular docking, which might be due to the transmembrane transport and metabolism. As a proof-of-concept, we show immunomodulatory effects of S-carvone and its methyl derivatives in the model of differentiated THP1 macrophages polarized into M1/M2 phenotypes.
abstract_zh: 单环单萜类化合物已被证明是芳基烃受体（aryl hydrocarbon receptor, AhR）的非典型负向别构调节剂。骨架的烷基化已被确定为调节S-香芹酮AhR拮抗活性的一个因素。在本研究中，我们合成了S-香芹酮的甲基化衍生物，并采用一系列复杂的实验方法来表征新化合物与AhR的相互作用。分子对接至AhR香芹酮结合位点显示，6-甲基化香芹酮的结合能优于S-香芹酮。这一预测通过微量热泳动（microscale thermophoresis）得到证实，其中6-甲基化香芹酮与AhR N端区域的结合比S-香芹酮更强。报告基因实验和RT-PCR显示，甲基化香芹酮在体外细胞系中抑制AhR转录活性。然而，其效应弱于分子对接预测的结果，这可能归因于跨膜转运和代谢。作为概念验证，我们在分化为M1/M2表型的THP1巨噬细胞模型中展示了S-香芹酮及其甲基衍生物的免疫调节作用。
